title: Password exactly 8 characters meeting all complexity rules is accepted
preconditions: Anonymous user on the register page (bookcart environment)
steps: Fill First Name, Last Name, User Name with valid data
Enter "Passw0rd" into the Confirm Password field
expected_result: No password-complexity validation error is shown; combined with otherwise-valid fields, the form submits successfully and the app redirects to /login (same success behavior as the happy-path case).

title: Password one character under the minimum length (7 chars) is rejected
preconditions: Anonymous user on the register page (bookcart environment)
steps: Fill First Name, Last Name, User Name with valid data
Enter "Passw0r" into the Confirm Password field
expected_result: Form is not submitted; the Password field shows a validation error indicating the password does not meet complexity requirements (min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit - exact message text not confirmed during exploration, verify wording on first execution); no POST /api/user/ request fires.
